evidence.excerpt: Existing work examines retrieval, updating, and question answering, leaving same-source record accumulation and post-correction persistence underexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In paired replay on 190 fixed questions across four memory frameworks, FPA raises accuracy from 0.825 to 0.920 with DeepSeek V4 Flash and from 0.782 to 0.916 with Kimi K2.6; mean Decision Contamination Effect falls from 0.106 to 0.030 and from 0.109 to 0.038, respectively.
